story: Verify Login Button Dimmed/Disabled by Default
description: Verifies that the Login button is disabled and dimmed by default without typing.

story: Button Dimmed When Phone Valid but Password < 8 Chars
description: Verifies that Login button remains disabled when phone is valid 11 digits but password is less than 8 characters.

story: Button Dimmed When Password Valid but Phone Incomplete
description: Verifies that Login button remains disabled when password is valid but phone number is incomplete.

story: Button Enabled When Valid Phone & Password >= 8 Chars
description: Verifies that Login button becomes enabled when valid 11-digit Egyptian phone and valid password >= 8 characters are entered.

story: Button Enabled When Valid Email & Password >= 8 Chars
description: Verifies that Login button becomes enabled when valid email address and valid password >= 8 characters are entered.

story: Type and Clear Identifier Triggers 'This field is required'
description: Verifies that typing and then completely clearing the identifier field displays 'This field is required' error.

story: Whitespace-Only Identifier Triggers 'This field is required'
description: Verifies that entering whitespace-only into the identifier field auto-sanitizes and displays 'This field is required' error.

expectedErrorMessage: Phone number must be exactly 11 digits
description: Verifies that entering a phone number with less than 11 digits displays 'Phone number must be exactly 11 digits'.

expectedErrorMessage: Phone number must start with 010, 011, 012, or 015
description: Verifies that entering an 11-digit phone number with an invalid prefix (018) displays 'Phone number must start with 010, 011, 012, or 015'.
Verifies that entering a phone number with a landline prefix (02) displays 'Phone number must start with 01'.
Verifies that formatted phone numbers with dashes or spaces are sanitized and accepted without format errors.

expectedErrorMessage: Please enter a valid email address
description: Verifies that entering an email without '@' displays 'Please enter a valid email address'.

expectedErrorMessage: Please enter a valid email address
description: Verifies that entering an email missing top-level domain extension displays 'Please enter a valid email address'.
Verifies that uppercase email with leading/trailing spaces is automatically trimmed and converted to lowercase.

story: Password Length < 8 Characters Keeps Login Button Disabled
description: Verifies that entering a password with less than 8 characters keeps the Login button disabled without inline error.
Verifies toggling password visibility reveals and masks the password correctly.
Verifies that a user can successfully log into Appoynt application using valid Egyptian phone number and password.
Verifies that a user can successfully log into Appoynt application using valid email address and password.
Verifies that attempting to login with an unregistered phone number displays generic error message: 'Invalid phone number or password.'.
Verifies that attempting to login with registered phone and wrong password displays identical generic error message: 'Invalid phone number or password.'.
